name: com.reenbo.suif
description: Ultra-performant, modular, and declarative MVVM UI Toolkit framework for Unity 6+. Features zero-allocation data binding, SMACSS styling architecture, scoped window management, and out-of-the-box VContainer and Addressables integration.

samples.description: Demonstrates window creation, configuration, opening, closing, and transitions using SUIF Core.
Two-way data binding with ViewBinder, reactive properties, and ZString runtime text formatting.
Zero-allocation virtualized list view with view-model recycling and state preservation.
Runtime theme swapping, CSS variables/classes, and SMACSS 5-layer style architecture.
Modal stacking, confirmation dialogs, back-stack management, and input blocking.
